name: Reverse Linked List
description:
Reverse a singly linked list in-place.

Given the `head` of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return the new head pointer.
hints: Keep three pointers: `prev` (initially nil), `curr` (initially head), and `next`.
Before changing curr.Next, save it to `next = curr.Next` so you don't lose the remainder of the list.
Set `curr.Next = prev`, then shift both pointers forward: `prev = curr`, `curr = next`. Repeat until curr == nil. Return prev.
